settings.heading: Hi, I'm Theo Marlow
settings.text:
I used to buy books faster than I read them. Ten years ago I started reading twenty pages a day and keeping one page of notes for every book. I have kept both habits since.

I write Marginalia, a short letter every Sunday on what I am reading and how to make it stick. Read More, Keep More is everything I have learned, in one book.

settings.heading: What readers say
settings.text: These words are samples to show the layout. Replace them with what your own readers write.

settings.quote: I finished more books in the three months after reading this than in the whole year before it. The twenty page rule is so simple it feels like cheating.
settings.name: Hannah Keller

settings.quote: The chapter on notes changed how I read. One page per book, and I can tell you what every one of them was about.
settings.name: Omar Siddiqui

settings.quote: Short, practical and kind. No reading challenge guilt, just a habit that fits in a lunch break.
settings.name: Julia Brandt

settings.quote: I gave it to my book club and now we all keep the same notes page. Our meetings are better for it.
settings.name: Marcus Lee

settings.quote: I quit three books I was dragging through and read five I loved instead. Permission to stop was the best part.
settings.name: Priya Nair
